name: Bishop's Lodge, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This historic ranch resort sits on 317 acres where Archbishop Jean Baptiste Lamy once built his private retreat in the 1850s, creating Santa Fe's most storied luxury escape.
whats_special: The property features original adobe chapel ruins and maintains working horse stables, while offering direct access to Dale Ball Trail system for world-class hiking and mountain biking. The resort's SkyFire restaurant serves elevated Southwestern cuisine using ingredients from their on-site organic garden.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise horseback ride to Shaman's Cave - you'll have exclusive access to ancient petroglyphs that most Santa Fe visitors never see.
dont_miss: The Thursday evening "Sunset & S'mores" experience around the fire pit, and exploring the historic chapel where Georgia O'Keeffe once sketched. The resort is just 10 minutes from Santa Fe Plaza but feels worlds away in the Sangre de Cristo foothills.
pros: Historic ranch property with authentic Santa Fe charm and character
Stunning mountain and desert landscape views in serene setting
Extensive outdoor activities including horseback riding and hiking trails
Award-winning spa with traditional Southwestern treatments
cons: Remote location outside downtown Santa Fe
